promotion_evidence.policy: Promote only when Wood IoU improves on an independent real test while DBH and volume do not regress.

wan_held_out.dataset: Wan et al. 2021 real TLS spatial held-out split
wan_held_out.scope: Pooled per-point metrics on the recorded held-out loader.
wan_held_out.limitation: The same held-out loader was used for best-epoch selection, and the final checkpoint/tree-ID provenance needed for an independent promotion gate is not available.

synthetic_held_out.scope: Synthetic evidence only; it cannot promote the production default.

demol_65.dataset: Demol et al. 2021 isolated-tree TLS validation
demol_65.scope: Isolated-tree inputs capped at 20,000 points, min-Z normalization, tlsep wood/leaf separation, and QSM-derived geometry only.
demol_65.excludes: This does not validate full-pipeline stages 1-4, species classification, allometric biomass, carbon stock, CO2e, or certified credits.

capabilities.name: 1. Ground segmentation
capabilities.claim: Operational heuristic; not Cloth Simulation Filter (CSF).

capabilities.name: 2. Height normalization
capabilities.implementation: K-nearest-neighbor inverse-distance interpolation of ground height

capabilities.name: 3. Canopy height model
capabilities.implementation: Grid maximum Z with morphological filling/smoothing
capabilities.claim: Operational CHM; not the full multi-threshold pit-free algorithm.

capabilities.name: 5a. Wood/leaf baseline
capabilities.implementation: tlsep/PCA geometric classifier selected as the stable default
capabilities.claim: Reproducible baseline/fallback; no real-data accuracy claim is assigned to tlsep here.

capabilities.name: 5b. PointNet++ wood/leaf candidate
capabilities.implementation: PointNet++ backend exists but is not the promoted default
capabilities.claim: Wan held-out Wood IoU 0.418 and Mean IoU 0.613, with selection/provenance limitations; not production-promoted.

capabilities.name: 6. QSM-derived geometry
capabilities.implementation: RANSAC circle DBH, maximum-Z height, and taper/stacked-cylinder stem volume; branch volume is zero
capabilities.claim: Operational geometry estimate with known volume limitations; not full TreeQSM branch-axis modelling.

capabilities.name: 7. Species classification
capabilities.implementation: Interface placeholder; pipeline uses a caller-supplied default species or no species
capabilities.claim: No trained ResNet species classifier is integrated.

capabilities.name: 8. Allometric carbon calculation
capabilities.implementation: species_db.csv species-specific equations with Chave 2014 pantropical fallback
capabilities.claim: Produces biomass, carbon stock, and CO2e estimates; coefficient verification against TGO 2017 remains required.

capabilities.name: Deterministic core demo
capabilities.implementation: Seeded synthetic fixture is executed twice and normalized JSON/PLY hashes must match
capabilities.claim: Reproducibility evidence for one core path, not an accuracy benchmark.

capabilities.name: Async analysis jobs
capabilities.implementation: FastAPI jobs endpoints, persistent job state, and a separate worker process
capabilities.claim: Implemented and covered by API tests; production hosting is separate.

capabilities.name: Web 3D result viewer
capabilities.implementation: Next.js dashboard viewer renders segmented PLY results and tree summaries
capabilities.claim: Implemented web visualization; generated evidence labels must accompany demo claims.

capabilities.name: Mobile capture flow
capabilities.implementation: Flutter capture and result screens exist, but Supabase initialization and the reviewed end-to-end path are incomplete
capabilities.claim: Prototype UI only; not a verified production scan-to-carbon flow.

capabilities.name: Production API/worker deployment
capabilities.implementation: Current verified demo uses a local backend exposed through a temporary tunnel
capabilities.claim: Not continuously deployed as a production ML service.

capabilities.name: Carbon marketplace and payments
capabilities.implementation: Product concept only; no complete transaction/payment path
capabilities.claim: Roadmap item, not an implemented B2B marketplace.

capabilities.name: Certified carbon credits
capabilities.implementation: No MRV registry verification, project certification, issuance, or retirement workflow
capabilities.claim: Carbon stock and CO2e estimates must not be described as certified or tradable credits.

core_demo.scope: Core reproducibility fixture; not an accuracy, field, allometric, or credit-certification benchmark.
